records.publisher: SEC — Bitwise XRP ETF Form S-1/A
claims: Coinbase Credit Inc is the Trade Credit Lender, Coinbase Inc is the Agent/Prime Execution Agent and Coinbase Custody is the custodian/agent for the Trust XRP Account.

Coinbase Credit may extend short-term cash and/or XRP trade credits for purchases or sales on Coinbase's Trading Platform; the interval is 24 hours and repayment is generally due by 6:00 p.m. ET the following calendar day.
The Trust grants a continuing first-priority security interest, lien and set-off right over its Trading Balance and Trust XRP Account to secure credits and fees.
Following an Event of Default, Coinbase Credit/Agent may exercise secured-creditor remedies, take control of the Trading Balance and Trust XRP Account and liquidate XRP or cash.
The filing says the Agent Execution Model is rare and limited; the Trust expects nearly all normal activity to use a Trust-Directed Trade Model with third-party counterparties.
The authorized credit amount and current outstanding utilization are not disclosed.
limitations: Contractual capacity does not establish actual borrowing or current encumbrance.
No default is asserted; liquidation is a conditional contractual remedy.
The Trust-Directed Trade Model is the expected normal route.

claims: The 22.48B XRP exchange-attributed total includes 48.4% cold-labelled, 14% hot-labelled and 37.8% unclassified balances.

The exchange table separately reports 327.4M Binance-Peg, a 1.6M discrepancy from the methodology breakdown.
The tracker attributes 5.81B XRP to Coinbase cold-labelled wallets and excludes ETF custody vaults without public exchange labels.
